description: This file is a Yocto recipe fragment (.inc) for building sanitized kernel headers for libc use in the Linux kernel version 5.4. It manages fetching, configuring, compiling, and installing kernel headers with specific handling for different architectures.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the kernel headers to the destination directory, removing conflicting files.

methods.name: do_install_append_aarch64
methods.description: Handles additional installation steps for aarch64 architecture.

methods.name: do_install_append_arm
methods.description: Handles additional installation steps for ARM architecture.

methods.name: do_install_append_armeb
methods.description: Handles additional installation steps for ARM big-endian architecture.

methods.name: do_install_armmultilib
methods.description: Copies multiple architecture-specific headers to support multi-lib builds.

methods.name: python anonymous
methods.description: Sets the header fetch version based on the major version number of the PV variable.
